package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const delay = 20 * time.Second

// ErrMode identifies an unsupported fault selection.
var ErrMode = errors.New("unknown fault mode")

func main() {
	path, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	mode, err := os.ReadFile(path + ".mode")
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	switch strings.TrimSpace(string(mode)) {
	case "crash":
		panic("controlled crash")
	case "empty":
		return
	case "timeout":
		time.Sleep(delay)
	case "slowgit":
		git(path)
	default:
		fail(ErrMode)
	}
}

func git(path string) {
	for _, arg := range os.Args[1:] {
		if arg == "ls-files" {
			time.Sleep(delay)
			return
		}
	}
	body, err := os.ReadFile(path + ".real")
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(string(body), os.Args[1:]...)
	cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		if cmd.ProcessState != nil {
			os.Exit(cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode())
		}
		fail(err)
	}
}

func fail(err error) {
	if _, writeErr := fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err); writeErr != nil {
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	os.Exit(2)
}
